name: aerospace
title: AeroSpace Tiling Window Manager
description: Control AeroSpace workspaces, windows, shortcuts, and configuration from Raycast
author: limonkufu

commands.name: showShortcuts
commands.title: Show AeroSpace Shortcuts
commands.description: View and trigger the shortcuts loaded by AeroSpace

commands.name: showConfig
commands.title: Show AeroSpace Config
commands.description: View the complete config file and the bindings loaded by AeroSpace

commands.name: goToWorkspace
commands.title: Go to Workspace
commands.description: Browse AeroSpace workspaces and their open apps

commands.name: shortcutsMenubar
commands.title: Enable AeroSpace Menu Bar Shortcuts
commands.description: View and trigger AeroSpace shortcuts from the menu bar

commands.name: switchApps
commands.title: Switch Apps in Workspace
commands.description: Find, focus, move, and tile open AeroSpace windows

preferences.name: defaultWorkspace
preferences.title: Default Search
preferences.description: Initial scope before you choose one. The window switcher remembers your latest selection.

preferences.name: aerospaceBin
preferences.title: AeroSpace Binary Path
preferences.description: Path to the AeroSpace CLI. Leave empty to detect common Homebrew and Nix locations.

preferences.name: showFullBindings
preferences.title: Show Full Bindings
preferences.description: Show bindings from every configured mode. Turn this off to show only the main mode.
preferences.label: Include bindings from every mode

preferences.name: showMenuBarExtras
preferences.title: Show Menu Bar Extras
preferences.description: Show Quick Actions and Open sections after the top-level binding catalog.
preferences.label: Show Quick Actions and Open sections

preferences.name: showWorkspaceName
preferences.title: Show Workspace Name
preferences.description: Show the current workspace beside the AeroSpace menu-bar icon.
preferences.label: Show the current workspace in the menu bar
